The '''Mission to Birix''' was a mission that occurred during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] at the same time as the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] and during it, the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Prudii Skirata|Prudii]] attempted to destroy a reactor on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] controlled world of [[Birix]].
